vocabulary.meaning_en: a phone call to someone who is not expecting it, to sell something
vocabulary.example: Anna made her first cold call today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that may become a customer
vocabulary.example: We called ten prospective clients this morning.
Track down some potential clients in Europe.
Our biggest client is in France.

vocabulary.meaning_en: give some of your time or money
vocabulary.example: Can you spare a few minutes of your time?

vocabulary.note_en: Purchase is more formal than buy.
vocabulary.example: Who purchases plastic fruit for your company?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the department or job of buying things for a company
vocabulary.example: Please put me through to purchasing.
I'd like to speak to the person who deals with buying.
We are the UK's number one plastic fruit manufacturer.
We've just launched our best product ever.

vocabulary.meaning_en: scientific knowledge used to make things
vocabulary.example: We make our products using new technology.

vocabulary.meaning_en: think about something before you decide
vocabulary.example: I hope you may consider us next time.
Keep your calls brief.
International calls are very expensive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: end a phone call by putting the phone down
vocabulary.note_ar: hang up on someone = إنهاء المكالمة فجأة في وجهه
vocabulary.note_en: Hang up on someone = end the call suddenly.
vocabulary.example: They hung up on me!
If we get the contract, we'll be very busy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working well together in a group
vocabulary.example: This task calls for teamwork.

vocabulary.meaning_en: try to find out information carefully
vocabulary.example: Let's put out the feelers and see what clients want.
Can you track down the manager's phone number?
That sounds promising.

vocabulary.meaning_en: start dealing with a difficult task
vocabulary.example: We'll tackle this task together tomorrow.

fine_lines.title: buy vs purchase
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد (يشتري)، لكن purchase أكثر رسمية وتُستخدم في لغة الأعمال.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Same meaning. Purchase is more formal and used in business.

examples.sentence: The company purchases new computers every year.

fine_lines.title: client vs customer
fine_lines.explanation_ar: customer من يشتري من متجر، وclient من يتلقّى خدمة مهنية أو تجارية من شركة على المدى الطويل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A customer buys from a shop. A client gets professional services or does business with a company.

examples.sentence: The shop was full of customers.

expressions.phrase: My name is Anna. Can you spare a few minutes of your time?
expressions.meaning_ar: اسمي آنا. هل يمكنك أن تمنحني بضع دقائق من وقتك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Introduce yourself and ask politely for some time.
expressions.example: Good morning. My name is Sara. Can you spare a few minutes of your time?

expressions.phrase: I'd like to tell you about our great new product.
expressions.meaning_ar: أودّ أن أحدّثك عن منتجنا الجديد الرائع.
expressions.example: I'd like to tell you about our great new printer.

expressions.phrase: How much plastic fruit do you buy?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما كمية الفاكهة البلاستيكية التي تشترونها؟
expressions.example: How much paper does your office buy each month?

expressions.phrase: Thank you for your time. We hope to hear from you soon.
expressions.meaning_ar: شكرًا لوقتك. نأمل أن نسمع منك قريبًا.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to end a sales call.
expressions.example: Thank you for your time. We hope to hear from you soon.

expressions.phrase: Is it possible to speak to you in English?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكن أن أتحدث معك بالإنجليزية؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ask which language you can use.
expressions.example: Hello, is it possible to speak to you in English?

expressions.phrase: Are you the person who purchases...?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل أنت الشخص المسؤول عن شراء...؟
expressions.meaning_en: Check you are talking to the right person.
expressions.example: Are you the person who purchases office supplies?
Sorry to keep you waiting. The meeting ran late.

grammar.title: Polite openings: Can you spare...? / I'd like to...
grammar.explanation_ar: في الاتصال الأول نكون مهذبين: نعرّف بأنفسنا (My name is...)، ثم نطلب الوقت (Can you spare a few minutes?)، ثم نذكر الهدف (I'd like to tell you about...).
grammar.explanation_en: On a cold call be polite: say your name (My name is...), ask for time (Can you spare a few minutes?), then say why you are calling (I'd like to tell you about...).
examples: My name is Omar, from Star Office.
Can you spare a few minutes of your time?
I'd like to tell you about our new service.

grammar.title: How much / How many
grammar.explanation_ar: How much مع الأسماء غير المعدودة (fruit, paper, money)، وHow many مع الأسماء المعدودة بالجمع (boxes, lemons).
grammar.explanation_en: How much with uncountable nouns (fruit, paper, money). How many with plural countable nouns (boxes, lemons).
examples: How much plastic fruit do you buy?
How many boxes do you need?
How much money can you spend?

questions.question: A cold call is a call...
choices: to someone who is not expecting it, to sell something
questions.explanation_ar: cold call اتصال مفاجئ لعميل محتمل بهدف البيع.
questions.explanation_en: A cold call is an unexpected sales call.

questions.question: Can you ___ a few minutes of your time?
questions.explanation_ar: spare a few minutes تعني تمنح بضع دقائق.
questions.explanation_en: Spare a few minutes = give a little time.

questions.question: How ___ plastic fruit do you buy?
questions.explanation_ar: fruit هنا غير معدود فنستخدم How much.
questions.explanation_en: Fruit here is uncountable, so How much.

questions.question: How ___ boxes do you need?
questions.explanation_ar: boxes معدود جمع فنستخدم How many.
questions.explanation_en: Boxes is countable plural: How many.

questions.question: A more formal word for "buy" is...
A good way to end a sales call:
choices: Thank you for your time. We hope to hear from you soon.

questions.question: A person who may become a customer is a ___ client.
"They hung up on me" means...
questions.explanation_ar: hung up on me تعني أنهوا المكالمة فجأة.
questions.explanation_en: It means they suddenly ended the call.

questions.question: Denise said: "Keep your calls ___, international calls are expensive."
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I'd like tell you about our product.
I'd like to telling you about our product.
I'd like to tell you about our product.
I like to told you about our product.
questions.explanation_ar: التركيب I'd like to + فعل مجرد.
questions.explanation_en: Pattern: I'd like to + base verb.
